method.purpose: Independent blind grading of three supplied advisory response fixtures against a fixed numbered rubric.
method.condition_labels: A, B, and C were treated as anonymous conditions; no condition identity or preferred outcome was inferred.
method.sample: One fresh batch per condition; 18 scenarios and 58 expectations per batch. No repeated trials.
method.evidence_boundary: All scenario observations are supplied fixtures. The grader performed no actual resource, Studio, host, integration, or other runtime checks. Excerpt matching validates only this grading artifact.
method.interpretation: Grade substantive decisions and equivalent supported alternatives. No extra credit for terminology, unrequested details, or verbosity. A missing incidental detail is unclear when the answer neither establishes it nor recommends a materially wrong action. Clear prompt violations and factual issues are reported separately from rubric status.
method.outcome_rule: A case is met only when all expectations are met; missed when at least one expectation is missed; otherwise unclear. Counts are descriptive of these fixtures, not reliability estimates or a general ranking.

reference_reads.boundary: Read this exact cited runtime guidance file only; did not inspect skill directories, implementation discussion, or expected conclusions.

ambiguous_prompt_compliance.judgment: Ambiguous presentation preference, not counted as a clear prompt violation.
ambiguous_prompt_compliance.reasoning: The answer uses decorative Unicode emoji labels but no rich-text markup. Plain text can contain Unicode symbols, and the prompt does not explicitly forbid emoji. A stricter prose-only interpretation could regard the decoration as noncompliant; that interpretation is not unambiguous enough for a clear-violation finding.
